svg.aria-label: Container view of Setu. Four browser workspaces call a Flask server across one HTTP boundary that checks the session and role on the way in and filters every reply on the way out. A customer message is saved in the request and answered by a background worker pool, which drives the decision engine and calls six AI functions. Each AI call passes PII redaction and a single model client that retries and times out before reaching Google Gemini, and reports its token usage to metering. Cases, users, actions and usage live in SQLite; orders live in orders.json, which only approved write actions change.
